name: rag-production-hardening
description: Offline-first RAG evaluation bench on a synthetic corpus: frozen datasets, sealed confirm-only holdout, 10 pre-registered arms, external-judge metrics (no LLM-as-judge), multi-stage process-kill recovery, 20-session concurrency isolation. v0.2.1 adds a machine-checkable evidence verifier and full-recompute CI. MIT.
